svg.title: About Aditya
svg.desc: Aditya works in enterprise data management at Prospecta Software, holds a BCA in Data Science and AI, is an AWS Community Builder and writes for the AWS Community.

g.text: I work where enterprise data meets decisions. As a Solutions Consultant at Prospecta Software, my
days go into SAP master data, enterprise data migration and the unglamorous, high-stakes job of
turning a business requirement into a data solution that holds up in production. My background is
analytics, so before I build anything I ask one question: what decision is this number supposed to
change?
I hold a BCA in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence from Babu Banarasi Das University,
Lucknow, and I keep my engineering hands warm with computer vision, predictive modelling,
dashboards and a lot of competitive programming.
Beyond the day job: AWS Community Builder (AI Engineering), writer for the AWS Community, former
Microsoft ambassador and founder of Mahir Insight Institute. Off the clock, I make lifestyle
content as AdityaLives.
Data informs decisions. Products evolve through insights. Strategy creates competitive advantage.
